title: Step 7 — the settlement precondition: 8,000,000 tCeBM held
description: The payer bank's tCeBM balance is non-zero. Until it is, every HTLC lock in this flow fails. This is the pre-condition half of the settlement assertion; mock-pvp-hp-17 is the post-condition.
notes: Gateway: Banco de San Jose commercial-bank gateway. The remaining 2,000,000 fCeBM stays as fiat token and is untouched by this settlement.
